prompt: Predict the initial (β-hydroxy) product of the aldol reaction of acetaldehyde with itself under dilute base.

traps.note: That's the dehydrated (crotonaldehyde) product — requires heat or stronger base.

explanation: Under mild base and cold, aldol stops at the β-hydroxy aldehyde; heat drives E1cb dehydration to the α,β-unsaturated product.
